topic: GTM troubleshooting: verify GTM makes the correct call
queries: how do I check my GTM call is correct
how to inspect the Kelkoo GTM request
check leadtag and kkstrack values in the call
developer console check for Kelkoo tag
content:
To verify your GTM integration is making the right call:

1. Log in to your Kelkoo Group Merchant Extranet and click **View your Kelkoo store page** at the top right of the Home page.
2. Click one of your offers to get redirected to your website.
3. Open the developer console (usually F12, or right-click → inspect element) and go to the **Network** tab.
4. Look for a `/gtm` call.
5. Open the `/gtm` call content (right-click the call → open in new tab).
6. Check that a **leadtag** value appears in the page.
7. Check that a **kkstrack** value appears, and that merchantId and country are correct.
section_heading: Verify that your GTM makes the correct call

queries: the orderId variable keeps coming back blank
GTM tag fires but values are empty
content:
**Integration not working at all** — make sure you have actually published the integration.

**orderId / orderValue undefined when the Kelkoo Group tag fires:**

- Verify you removed all existing Kelkoo Group tags.
- Re-install from scratch using the current GTM template: https://www.kelkoogroup.com/support/merchants-support/google-tag-manager-integration/
- Check the variables used for orderId/orderValue in the template are the right ones — in GTM debug mode during a test sale they must not be undefined when the Kelkoo Group tag fires.
- Undefined variables often mean you are using Google conversion tag variables that get pushed into the dataLayer *below* the GTM snippet on the confirmation page.
- If the variables are declared after the GTM snippet, the firing trigger must be **Page View - DOM ready** instead of **All Pages Page View**.

topic: GTM troubleshooting: dataLayer ordering and DOM ready trigger
queries: datalayer and GTM called in wrong order
datalayer must be above the GTM snippet
DOM ready trigger for Kelkoo tag
why does my tracking flip between V1 and V2
Kelkoo tag not triggered on DOM ready
content:
**dataLayer / GTM called in the wrong order** — if you manually fill the GTM dataLayer with the kkstrack script in the page source, the order matters: the dataLayer must appear **above** the GTM snippet.

**Tag not triggered on DOM ready** — the Kelkoo Group tag must be triggered on the DOM ready event, not a custom event, so the variables are guaranteed available. Check this if you notice your installation constantly moving back and forth between Kelkoo Sales Tracking V1 and V2 in your Merchant Extranet.

topic: GTM troubleshooting: variable brackets and curly quote errors
queries: double brackets around variable names GTM
variable name not interpreted in GTM
why isn't my variable being substituted
content:
**Missing or wrong brackets** — in Google Tag Manager a variable is only interpreted if wrapped in double brackets. Do **not** write `'orderValue': 'dlv_revenue_media'`; write `'orderValue': '{{dlv_revenue_media}}'`. Brackets around the value are mandatory. Typing the opening double brackets pops up the list of available variables, which avoids typos.

**Wrong double quotes** — use the plain ASCII `"` character, not the UTF-8 curly quote `“`. The difference is subtle but breaks the tag.

Correct: `{country: "de", merchantId: "100522210"}, {country: "nl", merchantId: "100516712"}`

Wrong: `{country:“de”,merchantId:“100522210”},{country:“nl”,merchantId:“100516712”}`

**Tag priority** — if you use a GTM custom HTML tag, set priority to **3** in the tag's Advanced Settings so it fires before the Kelkoo Group Sales Tracking Tag.

topic: PrestaShop troubleshooting: variables, template and cache
queries: merchant ID and order value not substituted into the script
I edited the wrong PrestaShop template
content:
**Issue 1 — variables not replaced in the order confirmation page source.** Check there are no `{literal}` tags around the tag:

```
<script type="text/javascript">
    _kkstrack = {
...
```

**Issue 2 — wrong template.** You must edit the correct file for your PrestaShop version; verify which file you actually edited.

**Issue 3 — cache not refreshed.** After any file change you must refresh the cache: **Admin panel > Advanced > Performance > Refresh cache**.

topic: Shopify troubleshooting: tag placed in a device-specific section
queries: Shopify pixel not firing on all devices
Shopify tag only works on desktop
why does my Shopify tracking flip between V1 and V2
content:
The file where the lead tag is added can contain dedicated sections for mobile and desktop. Make sure the tag sits **outside** those sections so it fires on all devices.

Check this if you see your installation constantly moving back and forth between V1 and V2 in your Merchant Extranet.

topic: Shopify troubleshooting: currency format and comma issues on large order values
queries: big order totals showing up wrong on Shopify
content:
Some merchants hit problems with order values above 4 digits, where the Shopify currency format was `{{ amount_no_decimals }}` rather than the standard `{{amount}}`.

If Shopify uses another format, adapt the code for the `orderValue` and `price` attributes:

Money format | Rounded | Example | Code suggestion
{{ amount }} | No | 1,134.65 | orderValue: '{{ order.total_price \| money_without_currency \| remove: ',' }}',
{{ amount_no_decimals }} | Yes | 1,135 | orderValue: '{{ order.total_price \| money_without_currency \| remove: ',' }}',
{{ amount_with_comma_separator }} | No | 1.134,65 | orderValue: '{{ order.total_price \| money_without_currency \| remove: '.' \| replace: ',', '.' }}',
{{ amount_no_decimals_with_comma_separator }} | Yes | 1.135 | orderValue: '{{ order.total_price \| money_without_currency \| remove: '.' }}',
{{ amount_with_apostrophe_separator }} | No | 1'134.65 | orderValue: '{{ order.total_price \| money_without_currency \| remove: '\'' }}',
section_heading: Common Issue 2: Currency, and comma issues with Shopify integration

queries: lgtrk script on my confirmation page
do I need to remove old LeGuide code
content:
On your confirmation page, look for this line:

```
<script src="https://secure.cimg.leguide.com/js/lgtrk-1.3.min.js" type="text/javascript" async=""></script>
```

It must be removed. In your codebase it is generated by this block:

```
<script type="text/javascript"> var lgtrk_data = { version : "1.3", idshop : "29097548", pt : "purchase", price : "274.92", idp : "20156", qty_idp : "1", price_idp : "274.92" }; (function(a,b,c,d){ a=('https:' == document.location.protocol ? 'https://secure.' : 'http://') + "cimg.leguide.com/js/lgtrk-"+lgtrk_data.version+".min.js"; b=document;c='script';d=b.createElement(c);d.src=a;d.type='text/java'+c;d.async=true; a=b.getElementsByTagName(c)[0];a.parentNode.insertBefore(d,a); })(); </script>
```
